Your community will likely appreciate the effort you put into making something special, regardless of how much it costs. If you're still feeling overwhelmed, you could also consider talking to your mother about your concerns and seeing if there are any other options or alternatives that might work for your family. Perhaps you could team up with another family to make a joint dish, or offer to bring a smaller contribution, like a batch of homemade cookies or a fruit salad. Remember, the goal of the community harvest celebration is to come together and share in the spirit of gratitude and community, not to put a strain on your family's budget. I hope these suggestions help, and I'm sure your contribution will be appreciated, no matter what!
